snippet.title: DMZ: Nuclear Survival Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
【Steam Page】
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316500/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=snsm&utm_campaign=20250503-trailer-desc&utm_content=en

DMZ: Nuclear Survival is an open-world survival crafting game set in a post-apocalyptic world following nuclear warfare. Developed by Wild Dog, a two-person team based in Saitama, Japan, this game offers a unique blend of strategy, exploration, and survival mechanics.


Key Features:

【Build a Private Military Company】 
・Establish and manage your own PMC to navigate the challenges of a devastated world.

【Train Survivors into Soldiers】
・Recruit and train survivors to bolster your ranks and enhance your chances of survival.

【Explore a Vast Procedurally Generated Map】
・Venture through diverse terrains and uncover the secrets of a world reshaped by catastrophe.

【Discover Relics from Ancient Ruins】
・Uncover artifacts that tell the stories of civilizations lost to time.

【Overcome Challenges to Survive】
・Face and conquer the numerous obstacles that stand between you and survival.


As the world has fallen, your story begins. Add DMZ: Nuclear Survival to your wishlist and stay connected for the latest updates:

【Twiter - 𝕏】 
https://x.com/DMZ_Game_EN
